verdict.rationale: Mistral's docs claim strong multilingual OCR across 40+ languages, but a hands-on community test specifically on a bidirectional English/Hebrew (RTL) document found the Hebrew output had no correspondence to the source text at all, directly contradicting the claim of equal fidelity for RTL scripts. No CJK-specific evidence (positive or negative) is present to corroborate the docs' broad claim either. Missing for 10: independent CJK-language accuracy testing, resolution/acknowledgment of the RTL failure, and benchmark data broken out by script type.
